claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft takes place in Pittsburgh, PA.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held near Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held near Point State Park.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on NFL Network.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on ABC.
The 2026 NFL Draft will have coverage on ESPN.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday, April 23 at 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday, April 24 at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday, April 25 at Noon ET.
The 2026 NFL Draft is the 91st edition of the NFL Draft.
The 2026 NFL Draft is the first time Pittsburgh is hosting the NFL Draft since 1948.
The time allowed for first-round selections in the 2026 NFL Draft has been shortened to eight minutes.
